task.name: Serve_cheese_pairing
task.when: During cheese service from 6:00 p.m. to 8:30 p.m.

step.action: Complete 📋 Prepare_cheese_station.
Lay a small batch of crackers on 🍷 Cheese_Serving_Trays with clean gloved hands.
Cut 🍷 Cheese_of_the_Day into pieces that fit the crackers.
Place one cheese piece on each cracker.
Cover prepared cheese crackers with 🍷 Food_Covers between servings.
Use 🍷 Serving_Tongs to place each serving in a guest's cup or napkin.
Measure the displayed cheese with 🍷 Food_Probe_Thermometer when replenishing a tray.
step.ifThen: IF the cheese is above 41°F, THEN remove it from service and tell the Food Lead.

step.action: Record each temperature on 🍷 Food_Service_Checklist.
Remove the used gloves and put them in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Spray the thermometer probe with 🍷 Multisurface_Cleaner.
Wipe the probe with 🍷 Disposable_Towels until no cheese remains.
Dampen a new disposable towel with potable water from 🍳 Drinking_Water_Dispensers.
Wipe every cleaned part of the probe with the damp towel.
Put the used towels in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Spray the probe with 🍷 Food_Surface_Sanitizer until it is visibly wet.
Leave the probe visibly wet for 60 seconds.
Allow the probe to air dry.
Wash your hands at 📦 Handwashing_Station.
Put on one clean pair from 🍷 Disposable_Food_Gloves.
Consolidate the remaining servings onto one tray before replenishing the other tray.
Prepare small batches so the cheese lasts through 8:30 p.m.

passWhen.criterion: No bare hand or guest contact occurred with ready-to-eat food.
Displayed cheese stayed at or below 41°F and temperatures were recorded.
The thermometer probe was cleaned, rinsed, sanitized, and air-dried after each reading.
Hands were washed and gloves changed after cleaning the thermometer.
Prepared food stayed covered between servings.
Cheese service continued through 8:30 p.m. or until the approved supply was exhausted.
